vars.name: pi_revenue_pct
vars.label: Percent of annual revenue from selling PI

vars.name: opt_out_link
vars.label: "Do Not Sell My Personal Information" link provided

vars.name: consumer_opted_out
vars.label: Consumer has directed the business not to sell

definitions.name: covered_business
definitions.label: Covered business
definitions.plain: A business that meets the revenue, consumer-count, or PI-revenue-share threshold.

definitions.name: sp_exception
definitions.label: Service provider exception
definitions.plain: The recipient is a service provider, under a written contract, acting for a business purpose.

definitions.name: third_party_disclosure
definitions.label: Third-party disclosure
definitions.formula: and(discloses_pi, or(is(recipient, third_party), and(is(recipient, service_provider), not(sp_exception))))
definitions.plain: Personal information reaches a third party, or a nominal service provider outside the contract exception.

definitions.name: sell
definitions.label: Sell
definitions.plain: A third-party disclosure made for money or other valuable consideration.

definitions.name: share
definitions.label: Share
definitions.plain: A third-party disclosure for cross-context behavioral advertising, with or without payment.

rules.label: Opt-out link duty (sell or share)
rules.plain: A covered business that sells or shares personal information must provide a "Do Not Sell" link.

rules.label: No sale or share after opt-out
rules.plain: A covered business must not sell or share the personal information of a consumer who has opted out.
